description: This PHP file defines a SOAP web service endpoint for managing custom fields within the SuiteCRM system. It includes a function to create or update custom fields for modules, handling authentication, permission checks, and layout modifications.

classes.name: SoapError
classes.description: Class used to handle SOAP errors and generate error responses.

methods.name: set_custom_field
methods.description: Creates or updates a custom field for a specified module, performing permission checks, and optionally adds the new field to the module's layouts.
